plainTranslation: Their Mars in your 8th house charges intimacy, shared power, money, and sexual trust. It can feel magnetic and consuming. Do not let intensity replace emotional safety; name power dynamics early.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
